termZh: : 活动视图- 过渡类型( )
definitionZh: 函数 :活动-视图-过渡型() CSS 假类 匹配元素 当一个带有一个或多个特定类型的视图过渡正在进行中(正在活动),并在视图过渡完成后停止匹配.
sourceDefinition: The functional :active-view-transition-type() CSS pseudo-class matches elements when a view transition with one or more specific types is in progress (is active) and stops matching once the view transition has completed.

sourceEvidence.sourceDefinition: The functional :active-view-transition-type() CSS pseudo-class matches elements when a view transition with one or more specific types is in progress (is active) and stops matching once the view transition has completed.
